id: title:Gilbert09:measure pipeline run attempts to expose retry amplification

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse pipeline run attempt metrics to PostHog's observability, enabling the team to distinguish between transient failures and repeated restarts of warehouse ingestion workflows.
review.reason: The change adds a histogram metric recording warehouse pipeline run attempts. This is a substantive, bounded improvement to the warehouse ingestion and monitoring capability, allowing PostHog to distinguish between single failures and repeated restarts. The implementation and relevant checks are visible in the supplied hunks.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit of distinguishing repeated restarts is not demonstrated by the code, only the addition of the metric. No production incident or adoption is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected.

observations.behavior: Adds a new metric recording the number of workflow attempts for warehouse pipeline runs.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to distinguish between a single failed attempt and repeated restarts of the same pipeline run, helping diagnose resource contention or configuration issues.
